items.item_text: Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.
Live Scan Background Check: A Live Scan background check must be completed prior to the start of employment.
Age Requirement: Candidate(s) must be 18 years or older to be eligible to be hired.
Ability to work weekends and evenings as needed. (Required)
Position is hybrid, and incumbent is required to work a minimum of 2-days per week on site (Required)
Bachelor's Degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training
2 years Minimum of demonstrated annual giving or fundraising experience and/or prior experience in a related field such as sales, marketing or business development.
Experienced with Blackbaud CRM or comparable donor/development databases, leveraging data systems to generate reports and support fundraising activities.
Experience in establishing, managing, and evaluating strategic partnerships, collaborations, and initiatives, building support among internal stakeholders and external organizations.
Experience in conceptualizing, planning, and executing special events that advance organizational engagement, fundraising, and relationship-building objectives.
Exceptional written communication skills with experience preparing reports, proposals, business correspondence, fundraising materials, and event communications.

Demonstrated integrity and discretion in handling confidential information, with experience recruiting, training, motivating, and managing staff and volunteers to support development and fundraising objectives.

When you join UCLA Extension (UCLAx) as our Associate Director of Development and Corporate Sponsorships, you become part of our force for change and transformation in this vital role to raise funds that keep this momentum going and ensure that all generations benefit from the legacy that is uniquely and distinctly UNEX. As one of the nation's oldest, largest, and most comprehensive continuing and professional studies providers, UCLAx gives students a wide range of options to expand career opportunities, switch careers, or achieve personal growth. We encourage you to bring your strong experience in fundraising, commitment to excellence, and drive for success to this role. This is a great opportunity to bring your passion for engagement, zest for fundraising and high ambitions to advance our continuing education programs. As the Associate Director, you will be a member of UCLA Extension's inaugural frontline fundraising team responsible for the identification, cultivation and solicitation of annual gifts, with a specific focus on soliciting gifts ranging from $5,000 to $75,000. You will identify and manage a portfolio of prospects, sponsors and donors and will create individualized cultivation and solicitation strategies and timetables. You will strategize and oversee execution of a variety of UCLAx cultivation events with a focus on gifts that support annual operations. You will also support and/or manage corporate sponsorship event strategies and oversight. In addition, you will work in partnership with the Assistant Dean, External Affairs, and other Extension team members on a wide variety of fundraising projects and initiatives and will be a strong contributor to the broader mission of the External Affairs office. When you join us as our Associate Director of Development and Corporate Sponsorships, you will be a valued member of our team, supported by leadership and will receive the tools and inspiration to grow and make significant achievements as part of our environment of excellence.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and data management tools, including database reporting, market segmentation, and data analysis.
Strong knowledge of fundraising principles and annual giving strategies within complex organizations, including higher education and research institutions.
Skilled in identifying, cultivating, and soliciting donors and partners through targeted relationship management and engagement strategies.
Proficient in researching prospective funders, analyzing funding opportunities, and developing compelling value propositions and partnership recommendations.
Strong verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to persuasively articulate organizational missions, priorities, and fundraising goals.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands, work independently, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills, capable of building and sustaining productive relationships with diverse internal and external constituents.
